_spec: Chaining decision log for the golden case. Explains WHY each framework was chained in the order it was, what input each LLM stage received, and how the cumulative context was built. This log is critical for understanding multi-framework analysis quality — it explains the 'why' behind every chaining decision. Pipeline agents must produce this log for every multi-framework run.
case_name: Golden Case — Denied Rerouting After Delay

chain_decisions.rationale: MC99 runs first as an independent analysis (mode=none). Montreal Convention is the primary international treaty governing air passenger rights for international carriage. It is always analyzed independently to establish the international law baseline before applying domestic law on top.
chain_decisions.decision_notes: MC99 Art.19 (delay liability) is directly triggered. Art.21 (death/injury) loaded but explicitly not cited per precision rule §12.5 — no factual nexus to personal injury. Art.17 not loaded as the scenario involves delay not injury.

chain_decisions.rationale: CBA runs second with mode='all' — it receives ALL prior framework results (MC99) as context. This is correct because: (1) CBA is the domestic law and may supplement or independently ground violations; (2) providing MC99 context avoids the CBA LLM re-discovering ACTN_deny0001 as if it were novel, preventing duplicate action nodes; (3) CBA analysis can surface additional actions not relevant to MC99 (here: ACTN_noasst01).
chain_decisions.decision_notes: CBA correctly identified ACTN_noasst01 as a new action distinct from ACTN_deny0001. Art.175 §2 cited for contractual service obligation. Art.260 (baggage limits) correctly excluded — no baggage issue in this scenario. The chaining context prevented the CBA LLM from re-surfacing the rerouting refusal as if it were new — a key benefit of mode='all'.

shared_nodes: EVID_trscr001 (Evidence — same recording grounds both frameworks)
ROLE_carr0001 (ActorRole — same carrier agent in both violations)
ROLE_pass0001 (ActorRole — same passenger in both violations)
PACK_src00001 (SourcePack — single pack for all source files)

applicability_basis.required_because: Case.jurisdiction='BR', MC99.jurisdiction='INT'. Cross-jurisdiction gap detected during synthesis. Invariant VIII-3 requires a formal applicability basis.
